title: Call Sign Condor: Latino Soldiers Fighting in Ukraine
author: DW, LA Times Studios, Futuro Studios
description:
Why would someone decide to risk their life for a country that is not their own? What might they be searching for? From LA Times Studios and DW, in collaboration with Futuro Studios, Call Sign Condor is a podcast about the thousands of Latin American soldiers who are fighting in Ukraine —  for Ukraine. Through the stories of our protagonist, Condor, and his fellow soldiers, this four-part podcast series takes us inside the lives of Latin American men and women who’ve been fighting — some of them for years — in the war in Ukraine. Through their experiences of fear, loss, and belonging — even falling in love — host Carolina Chimoy explores what brought these soldiers to the front, how they’ve experienced the war, and what they've found there.
Carolina Chimoy is an international correspondent at DW’s headquarters in Berlin, currently covering the war in Ukraine. She previously served as DW’s U.S. correspondent in Washington, D.C., reporting on the White House, national security, and transatlantic relations.
Over the course of her career, Carolina has reported extensively from across Latin America, covering presidential elections in Brazil, Peru and Bolivia, as well as major political developments in the region. 
For this podcast, after realizing just how many Latinos have come to fight in this war in Ukraine, Carolina has immersed herself in the world of these soldiers. She’s observed not only how they live with a war that is not their own, but also how they have adapted to Ukrainian society, its climate and its culture.
Through Condor and other soldiers’ personal stories, she takes us into the reality of the trenches, but also into deeply human moments of relief and even happiness each has found. At the same time, she shows how these soldiers are also changing the lives of Ukrainians in their own country.

description:
Welcome to ULTIMO GOAT! I’m your host and reviewer, Tony T, and this is where we rank the matches and wrestling performances from every single AEW pay per view using “two distinct ranking systems”.

The GOAT Rating System ditches traditional stars for goats, grading matches on a scale where only absolute masterpieces hit that elusive, perfect 5 GOAT pinnacle.

The ULTIMO Five ranks the absolute best individual performances of the night, crowning the number one standout as the definitive GOAT of the pay per view.

The highest rated bouts punch their ticket to the GOAT Match of the Year showdown, while every pay per view winner advances to the year end finals to battle for the ultimate prize the ULTIMO Crown for GOAT Performance of the Year. 🐐

title: The Surrey Hills Portrait
author: Martin Bamford
description: The Surrey Hills Portrait shares conversations with the people who live, work and create across the Surrey Hills. Hosted by Cranleigh-based portrait photographer Martin Bamford, each episode explores a guest's work, experiences and story, accompanied by a portrait created especially for the series.

description: Welcome to the Faith, Increase & Destiny Podcast with Ben & Jewel Tankard, where biblical truth meets everyday life. Through practical teaching, powerful conversations, and faith-building wisdom, Ben and Jewel help you grow in your relationship with God, increase in every area of life, discover your purpose, and walk boldly in your God-given destiny. Each message is designed to strengthen your faith, expand your thinking, and equip you to live the life God has called you to live.

title: The Song Game

description: The greatest song never written. Every episode, a guest has to make all the important decisions: who’s singing it, what it sounds like, what it’s about and, crucially, whether it’s any bloody good. One question at a time, a song takes shape. Then it’s time to find out if it’s earned its place in The Songbook!

description: Behind the Final Cut is your monthly deep dive podcast into the art and craft of video editing with Final Cut Pro. We interview professional editors and creators to go behind the timeline, breaking down real-world workflows, editing techniques, and post-production secrets.

author: The 33rd Team
description:
What does it take to achieve greatness? Adam Thielen has spent his life pursuing the answer, and now he’s bringing you along for the journey. From the golf course to the gridiron and everything in between, Adam takes you inside the mind of elite athletes to discover what separates the good from the great. Through conversations with guests such as Baseball Hall of Famer Joe Mauer and Olympic Gold Medalist Matt Boldy, viewers will get the chance to peek behind the curtain at what makes star competitors tick. title: Weird News w/ Jon Pounders
author: Jonathan Pounders
description:
Weird News with Jon Pounders is a truth-seeking look at the strange, unexplained, and often overlooked stories that don’t fit the official narrative.Hosted by Jon Pounders—founder of Now You See TV and host of Pounders Quest—the show collects bizarre headlines, mysterious videos, high-strangeness reports, hidden-history clues, and current events that feel off. Stories range from unexplained phenomena and odd official reports to ritual-abuse claims, Tartaria/old-world architecture questions, Watchers/Nephilim connections, AI and tech developments, and spiritual-warfare angles the mainstream usually ignores.


poundersquest.com

Pounders approaches the material as a Christian investigator rather than a sensationalist. He filters the weird through Scripture, discernment, and a long-running interest in deception, secret societies, and end-times patterns. Guests and source material often come from the same circle of independent researchers he interviews on Pounders Quest. The tone is conversational, curious, and unfiltered—more “what does this actually mean?” than late-night tabloid shock.Typical episodes mix recent odd news with older suppressed or fringe reports, then ask how (or whether) they connect to larger spiritual and historical pictures. The goal is not just entertainment; it is to help viewers notice patterns, question official stories, and stay grounded in a biblical worldview while exploring the edges of what the world is willing to talk about.

title: Into The Starz With Marz!!!
author: MarzBarz89
description: This healing podcast explores the journey of emotional wellness, self-growth, and resilience. Featuring honest discussions, practical tools, and expert insights, each episode helps listeners process pain, build healthy coping skills, and cultivate self-compassion. Healing isn’t linear—and you don’t have to walk the path alone.

title: Puzzle Pieces Podcast
author: Puzzle Pieces Podcast
description:
The Puzzle Pieces Podcast brings honest conversations, practical guidance, and trusted resources to individuals with disabilities, families, caregivers, and the people who support them.
Hosted by the team at Puzzle Pieces, each episode explores topics that matter—from diagnosis, education, therapies, behavior, and advocacy to independence, employment, relationships, community resources, and life beyond services.
Our goal is simple: to help families feel informed, supported, and connected while creating greater understanding around disability in our community.

title: Better at Home with Myf Warhurst
author: Better Homes and Garden Real Estate Australia
description:
Better at Home is a video podcast about people who've built a home, and a life, that fits them. Some wanted more room to work with. Others were after something harder to pin down, the particular place that suited how they wanted to live.
Across six episodes, Myf Warhurst spends time in their homes and gardens and gets into the property journey behind each one, how they found the place and made it their own.
Brought to you by Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate Australia. Nobody knows homes better.

title: The Quiet Hour
author: Derek Bowen
description: Quiet Hour is a calm, reflective porch‑night broadcast created in Hagerstown, Maryland. Each episode blends atmospheric storytelling, meteorological perspective, and quiet cosmic imagery to create a steady end‑of‑day companion. No hype — just a grounded voice, a moment of stillness, and a look at the world from a quieter angle.

title: Home Turf with Jesse Carlson
author: Jesse Carlson
description:
Every community has people worth knowing.
Home Turf is where those conversations happen. Hosted by Jesse Carlson, the show brings together real estate professionals, business owners, industry experts, and community voices from across the Twin Cities for thoughtful, unscripted conversations about the work they do, the challenges they face, and the ideas shaping the places we call home.
Some episodes dive into housing and entrepreneurship. Others explore local history, leadership, or the stories behind the people making a difference. The common thread isn't the topic; it's the people.

title: The Plus One Club
author: The Plus One Club
description:
Welcome to The Plus One Club - As celebrity plus ones themselves, Sam Richardson’s gf Nicole and Nelson Franklin’s wife Georgia pull back the curtain on what it’s like being in the Plus One Club, chatting with spouses, siblings and best friends of your favorite celebs about how relatable our incredibly unrelatable lives can be. 

They dig into it all - last minute black tie invites, holding down the fort while your partner works out of town, ways we support our best friend’s career, or surviving an international press tour from the sidelines after pitching your own project to those very same people. 

Join us as we explore the uniquely privileged yet surprisingly humbling world of The Plus One Club.


Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

Pia’s Playhouse is an adult storytelling and interview podcast hosted by Pia Polamina.


Each episode opens a different door into Pia’s world, from witty conversations and personal interviews to seductive stories inspired by her own photos. With a mix of sensuality, humor, fantasy, and creative chaos, Pia turns images, ideas, and conversations into intimate audio experiences made to be heard, imagined, and felt.


Whether she’s talking with a guest, narrating erotic fiction, or pulling you into one of her fantasy-driven stories, Pia’s Playhouse is for listeners who enjoy adult storytelling, intimate audio, sensual conversations, and a world that leaves just enough to the imagination.


Want to get closer? Join VIPia for exclusive content, private drops, behind the scenes moments, and more from Pia at https://www.piasplayhouse.com/vipia.

title: After the Whistle: Inside BYU Football
author: Zach Halliday, Nate Church
description:
Welcome to After the Whistle, your stats-driven look at BYU football. Join co-hosts Zach Halliday and Nate Church as they go beyond the box score to break down the numbers, matchups and storylines that matter most for the Cougars.
From postgame analysis to in-depth previews, After the Whistle gives BYU fans a deeper understanding of the game and the trends shaping the season.
New postgame recaps every Tuesday throughout the football season, with upcoming game previews every Thursday.

title: The Snap Count
author: Scott Shearer
description:
Listen to The Snap Count with Scott to get the latest predictions and follow along with Scott as he scours the schedule for the next big story, score, or upset. 
Scott is just like you, spending Saturdays watching ball, coaching from the couch, and always trying to think of what's next.
Join Scott and bring your next water cooler talk to the comments as he shares his best opinions that are sure to create debate!

title: Your Daily Spanish Coach
author: Timothy Moser
description: Learn the tactics that elite Spanish coaches use to help serious adult learners become fluent in Spanish. Every weekday, Timothy Moser spends 3 minutes on one technique you can use that day. Episodes cover speaking without freezing, choosing vocabulary you'll actually use, memory devices to make sense of tricky grammar, training your Spanish ear and voice, and study habits you'll follow even on a bad week. It's what he tells his own coaching students at LearnCraft Spanish, built on 12 years of watching what works and what doesn't.

title: Trail To Tide
author: Brooke Moss
description:
Tune in every Wednesday at Noon for an inspiring outdoor show tailored for women, moms, families, and health-conscious outdoorsmen! From serene hiking trails to thrilling boating adventures, Brooke Moss guides you through unforgettable experiences featuring:
Expert tips for fishing, hiking, boating, beaching, and more
Family-friendly outdoor activities and adventures
Conservation stories that inspire sustainable living
Health-focused outdoor tips for active lifestyles

title: Beyond The Break Up With Robin
author: Beyond Th Brreak Up With Robin
description:
Beyond the Breakup with Robin is a podcast about divorce, family law, and what comes next. Hosted by Dallas family law attorney Robin Zegen, the podcast goes beyond the legal process to explore how divorce affects your family, finances, children, and future.

Drawing on more than three decades of family law experience, along with her own experience with divorce, Robin offers practical insights to help you understand your options, make informed decisions, and maintain more control over the process. Episodes explore collaborative divorce, co-parenting, financial concerns, life after divorce, and ways families can resolve conflict without making the courtroom the center of their lives.

Because divorce is not just an ending. It is also the beginning of what comes next.

title: Nature-Based Educator
author: Ade Hofmann
description:
The Nature-Based Director Podcast is for nature-loving, child-centered educators, founders, and directors who want to build and lead thriving nature- and play-based programs without losing themselves in the process.
Whether you're dreaming of starting a nature school, forest school, outdoor preschool, or nature-based early childhood program—or you're already deep in the work of leading one—this podcast offers practical guidance, honest conversations, and encouragement for the real-life challenges of outdoor education and program leadership.
Each episode explores topics like how to start a nature-based program, forest school leadership, outdoor learning, child-led play, enrollment, finances, staffing, policies, behavior and big emotions, teacher burnout, sustainable leadership, and navigating the unexpected as a program founder or director.
Hosted by Ade Hofmann, M.Ed., founder of Nature Play All Day and an educator and leader with nearly a decade of experience in nature-based schools and programs, this podcast is a place for both the practical questions and the things leaders don't always say out loud.
Because building something rooted in nature, play, and community is beautiful—but it can also be lonely, overwhelming, and full of decisions you never expected to make.
Here, you'll find tactical next steps, real-world stories, leadership support, and encouragement to help you move forward with greater clarity and confidence. We'll talk about how to transition from the conventional classroom to outdoor learning, how to start and grow a nature-based program, and how to build sustainable rhythms and routines that support your children, your team, your families, and you.
This work is not about doing it perfectly. It's about learning to trust the process, steward the program you've been entrusted with, and lead without sacrificing yourself in the name of your mission.
If you believe that children belong outside, that play is meaningful learning, and that nature has something powerful to teach us, you're in the right place.

Every week, Noa Solomon and Max Cohen, aka Murray Hill Boy, unpack the chaos of dating, friendships, internet culture and life as two young, chronically online Jewish New Yorkers trying to figure it all out in real time.
A Lost Tribe original podcast.

title: Breaking Down with Ford Sanders
author: Ford Sanders
description:
Breaking Down with Ford Sanders is your weekly pop culture catch-up with the personality, opinions, and occasional chaos the internet deserves. Former TV news reporter turned internet best friend Ford Sanders covers the biggest viral moments, social media drama, pop culture headlines, and internet discourse everyone's talking about, plus whatever chaos is unfolding in his own life.
Joined by friends, creators, and guests, Ford brings sharp wit, unfiltered opinions, and chaotic honesty to the conversations already happening in your group chat. Because sometimes you need someone to break down the news—and sometimes you just need to break down.

title: Seahawks Triple Option Podcast
author: Emerald City Spectrum
description: The Seahawks Triple Option podcast delivers exclusive insider access and expert perspectives that Seattle Seahawks fans won’t find anywhere else. Hosted by beat reporter Corbin Smith, former NFL running back Robert Turbin, and veteran draft analyst Rob Rang, the podcast brings 12s the deep-dive intel they crave from every imaginable angle, from breaking news out of the VMAC and hard-hitting film room analysis to comprehensive NFL draft scouting and exclusive guest interviews, the Seahawks Triple Option is your ultimate daily look behind the scenes, between the lines, and inside the locker room for the Pacific Northwest’s favorite professional sports franchise. Seahawks Triple Option is a proud part of Emerald City Spectrum, covering All Seattle Sports, All the Time.

title: Which Way, America?
author: whichwayamerica
description: What is happening to the moral fabric of America? What does the future hold for this remarkable nation? Join It Is Written Associate Speaker Eric Flickinger on an unforgettable journey through America’s past, present, and future as he explores the Bible’s most profound prophecies and reveals their relevance to our lives today. A sought-after speaker and host of It Is Written Sabbath School, Eric is able to make the most complex biblical topics accessible and engaging for all.

title: Texas Wesleyan Football
author: Texas Wesleyan Football
description:
Welcome to the official podcast feed for Texas Wesleyan University Football. This is where we drop everything we put on TV — the weekly coaches show and our game broadcasts — so y'all can catch the Rams wherever you are.

Each week you'll get Rams Up, our TV show breaking down the last game, looking ahead to the next one, and getting into the stuff that doesn't show up in a box score — including recurring segments like T.N.T. and Do Your 1/11. Then on game weeks, the full broadcast lands here too, so if you couldn't be in the stands or in front of a TV, you didn't miss it.

Texas Wesleyan football is about more than Saturdays. It's about building better men — on the field, in the classroom, and long after the last snap. Subscribe and follow along.

title: onedegree°
author: Mary Ardath
description:
One Degree is a leadership and personal growth platform designed to inspire, connect, and elevate women who are making an impact in public accounting. 
Built around the belief that extraordinary change often comes from a single decision, mindset shift, or courageous action, #1degree explores the moments that transform careers, businesses, leadership journeys, and lives. 
At 211 degrees, water is hot. At 212 degrees, it boils. onedegree changes everything. 
Every conversation seeks to uncover the onedegree that created meaningful change.

title: The Mysterious Files
author: TheMysteriousFiles
description:
Uncovering the hidden, the haunted, and the historically unexplained.
Join husband-and-wife duo Savannah and Jeff as they dive deep into the world’s most chilling enigmas. From the shadowed hallways of the Hotel Monte Vista to the cold trails of long-forgotten cold cases, Mysterious Files blends meticulous historical research with a passion for paranormal and criminal investigation.
Every episode, Savannah and Jeff peel back the layers of the unknown, exploring everything from lingering spirits in the Jean Harlow House to the gritty details of unsolved true crimes. They aren’t afraid to tackle the cases that haunt our collective memory—from famous hauntings to heartbreaking mysteries like the Little Jane Doe, seeking answers for those who have been forgotten by time.
With Savannah’s background in investigative research and Jeff’s collaborative storytelling, the pair unearths the human history and the baffling injustices left behind in the world’s most mysterious locations. Whether it’s a ghost story, a local legend, or a case that has stumped detectives for decades, they leave no file unopened.
New episodes every week. Grab your flashlight—it’s time to dig into the files.

title: Freep Sports Show
author: Detroit Free Press
description:
The Freep Sports Show is your home for Detroit and Michigan sports! When Dylan Larkin requests a trade, the Tigers send Tarik Skubal packing or the Lions get hosed by a ref, we'll be there with you to react. 
Hosted by longtime Detroit Free Press columnist Shawn Windsor and Freep sports staffer Andrew Birkle, the Freep Sports Show is our first major step in revamping how we get our award-winning content to you, the audience.
So what makes this podcast different than the millions of others that are out there? The answer is simple: We've got the best team of experts in local sports just a phone call away.
Dave Birkett (Lions), Helene St. James (Red Wings), Omari Sankofa II (Pistons), Chris Solari (Michigan State athletics), Tony Garcia (Michigan athletics), Jared Ramsey (high school sports), Christian Romo (trending news), Rainer Sabin (college football and NFL), and our team of legendary columnists (Shawn Windsor, Carlos Monarrez and Jeff Seidel) give us a never-ending rolodex of insiders ready to roll at a moment's notice.
If you've been searching far and wide for the right podcast that will discuss ALL your favorite teams in the Mitten State, look no further. We can't wait for you to join us, as we pride ourselves on engaging with commenters on livestreams and interacting as much as possible.
Join us for three shows a week, including a LIVE reaction show after every Detroit Lions game this season.
You can find every episode of the Freep Sports Show on Apple Podcasts, Spotify or YouTube. For more, visit freep.com/sports.

If you’ve ever felt stuck, broken, or ready to quit—this podcast is for you.

The work does not speak for itself. You have to give it a voice.

Hosted by Jay Lapointe | Visibility Strategist | J. August Media

title: Cher-ing Grief Podcast
author: Cher
description:
Welcome to the club no one wants to join, hosted by a grieving daughter with spicy brain and a dark sense of humor. It is a candid take of life after losing my mom. There may be some some wild rabbit holes, laughs at awkward parts of mourning, and spooky signs that loved ones haven't truly left. It's comforting, it's chaotic, and it's proof that grief can be hilarious, heartbreaking, and haunting all at once.
Let's have a gander: https://cheringgriefpod.substack.com

title: Theatre Charlotte Unscripted
author: Queen City Podcast Network
description:
Theatre Charlotte Unscripted is your backstage pass to the people, stories, and creativity behind Theatre Charlotte.

Hosted by local theatre fixture Hank West, each episode goes beyond the production to talk with the artists bringing our shows to life, uncover stories from Theatre Charlotte’s nearly 100-year history, and explore the people and ideas that make Charlotte’s theatre community so vibrant.

New episodes each month, with plenty of theatre talk, behind-the-scenes stories, and a few surprises along the way.

title: Blue Collar Theology
author: Chip and James
description: Welcome to the Blue Collar Theology Podcast with your hosts Chip and James. We are here to discuss everyday topics through the lens of biblical worldview to help strengthen our walk with Jesus Christ. "We are not scholars, just Blue Collar" is what we like to say around here because we live the everyday grind just like those listening. James and I may have been called into ministry, but the Lord still has us in the workforce until we are called elsewhere. So though we may not have all the answers, we will go to the source of truth, God's Word, to shape our worldview to combat difficult topics.

title: Cash or Crash
author: Adam Moore
description:
Cash or Crash is a weekly sports betting podcast hosted by longtime friends Adam and Tony, who first crossed paths working in minor league sports.

Since then, their careers have taken them in different directions. Adam moved into the music industry, while Tony stayed in sports, working with multiple professional franchises and college athletic programs. But the obsession with sports, and having an opinion on where to put your money, never went away.


Each week, Adam and Tony break down the bets they like, the ones they're staying away from, and the picks that could either cash…or crash. NFL and soccer take center stage, with plenty of other sports, bad beats, questionable decisions, and friendly disagreements mixed in along the way.


No tout nonsense. No pretending every pick is a lock. Just two friends talking sports, betting, and putting their picks on the record.


Welcome to Cash or Crash.

title: Disorder
author: Jason Pack
description:
Are you fed up with the never ending crises in the news? Are you looking for Order amidst the Disorder? Listen to the Disorder Podcast as we offer forward thinking solutions to the biggest challenges of the day.  
We are living through an age of unrivaled disorder: an out-of-control Trump Administration, never ending scandals, escalating threats from China, Iran, and Russia, and the rapid march of destabilizing tech. The “good guys” - rules-based ordering centrists - are on the back foot, while neo-populist strongmen gain ground by fuelling more and more chaos. But there are ways out of this mess. Join us as we Order the Disorder.
Each week, host Jason Pack, co-hosts Jane Kinnimont and Mark Lobel, world-leading experts, senior diplomats and cultural icons, present their solutions to problems like: why are centrists losing and populist strongmen winning? How do we save our democracies? How do we deal with threats from Disorderers like Iran and Russia? And how do we build multilateral coalitions that work, how can we regulate AI, defend Ukraine, and fight climate change? All in a world without American leadership? Disorder is the go-to podcast for anyone who wants intelligent, thoughtful solutions to the Disorder engulfing our mad mad mad mad world.
To join our Mega Orderers Club, and get ad free listening, early episode releases, bonus content and exclusive access to live events, visit ⁠disordershow.com/club
Website: https://disordershow.com/

title: Reminisce Uninterrupted
author: Rem
description: Reminisce Uninterrupted is a space for real stories, real people, and real honesty. It’s a podcast where creatives and unique professionals talk openly about how their careers shaped their mental health — and how their mental health shaped their careers. Through vulnerable conversations, unexpected humour, and reflective moments, each guest is given the space to reminisce uninterrupted and share the wisdom they wish they had when they first started.

title: Marvel's Wastelanders
author: Marvel | Realm
description:
Wolverine, Black Widow, Star-Lord, Hawkeye, and Doctor Doom will team up to stop Valeria Richards. She is the smartest woman on Earth, immortal and lonely beyond reason. After surviving a rain of nuclear missiles in Southern California and gaining possession of the reality warping Cosmic Cube, she was driven to the brink of madness. Something mysterious is unfolding in this irradiated “Dead Zone” and it’s up to our heroes to find out what, and to stop Valeria from committing an act of ultimate evil. Marvel's Wastelanders is the sixth and final installment in the “Marvel's Wastelanders” audio epic. Starring Dylan Baker as Doctor Doom, Timothy Busfield as Star-Lord, Stephen Lang as Hawkeye, Robert Patrick as Wolverine, and Susan Sarandon as Black Widow. Directed by Kimberly Senior. Original sound design by One Thousand Birds. Original music by Lindsay Jones. Story by Mark Waid. Written by Nick Bernardone, J Holtham, and Mark Waid.


Learn more at marvel.com/wastelanders.

title: Pendulum Noir
author: Ramona Nica
description: Welcome to Pendulum Noir. I'm Ramona, a criminology and psychology student, and I explore true crime through in-depth storytelling and podcast interviews. I look beyond the headlines, focusing on the people involved, the evidence and the questions surrounding each case. At the end of each episode, I also share my personal perspective on the case. For me, true crime is about more than what happened; it's about looking deeper, questioning the details and trying to understand the full story.

title: The Wild Game
author: Fox and Boar Games
description:
Roleplaying Game topics pushed to the wilds of imagination.

With over 40 years of experience in playing, running, writing and most recently publishing roleplaying games - John Harford brings you observations, reflections, tips and hot takes on RPG writing, running and game design.

Scenario creation, world building and game master techniques will be a regular feature, but there will also be discussion on gaming intersections and inspirations beyond the tabletop.

John runs Fox and Boar Games, with their top selling publications being TrashSexy: The Raccoon Roleplaying Game and ShadowWest - a supernatural western that uses the Shadowdark system. He also is the creator of Tales of the Harrowed Land - a dark fantasy setting and system as well as several Miskatonic Repository offering for Call of Cthulhu.

John is also a professor of system design and game narrative at Raritan Valley Community College. 

Check out Our Links:

title: Human Reset
author: Steve Denyer
description:
It's never too late to hit reset. Life doesn't always go according to plan: careers change, relationships end, health declines, confidence fades. Sometimes we simply lose sight of who we are.
Whether you're recovering from a setback, feeling stuck, or simply know you're capable of more, this isn't about chasing perfection; it's about creating your comeback.
Reset your health. Reset your life. Rewrite your future.
Learn more at https://www.thehumanreset.ca/

title: AIM 4 Holistic Health
author: John & Charlene Donelson
description:
AIM 4 HOLISTIC HEALTH

This podcast is simply a labor of love for eating and living healthy. A simple way to share and learn more about the various ways to gain and retain Holistic Health - the way God intended.

 As you listen to this podcast, please take what you need, share what you know, and become a part of the many who are being healed and restored from various sicknesses and diseases, holistically.

·In Focus: A companion episode with a deeper dive on evidence, implementation and future trends for ultrasound-guided care and technology.

title: The Permanent Questions With David Brooks
author: The Atlantic
description:
What makes us human? How can I find purpose in life? How can my relationship survive a rough patch? What do I say to a friend who’s suffering? Does any of this mean anything at all? 

It’s easy to lose sight of fundamental human concerns amid the churn of the news cycle and the demands of every day. Each week on The Permanent Questions, host David Brooks seeks to return them to our attention through thoughtful conversation with the world’s deepest thinkers.

title: One Little Why
author: Maryam Afshari
description: Have you ever looked at something ordinary and wondered, “Why?” One Little Why is all about the stories hiding behind the things we see, eat, use, and talk about every day. From money and words to food, traditions, places, and history, Maryam explores one simple question at a time — in a fun, friendly, and easy-to-understand way.

title: Tales From the Trade
author: talesfromthetrade
description:
Tales from The Trade is an exploration of sex workers' stories and creative endeavors. We don't always talk about sex work, but we do always talk as sex workers. The show aims to highlight a unique point of view that comes from being in "The Trade." Sometimes we criticize, sometimes we celebrate, and most times we laugh. Tune in to hear what sex workers are creating in arts and media, and to hear what we think about current events, film, literature, politics, religion, relationships, and more. 

Tales From the Trade is a part of YAS Work Network, a network of podcasts about sex workers by sex workers.

title: Build Your PT Clinic with Bryan Wright, DPT
author: Bryan
description:
You're a great physical therapist. So why is the business so much harder than the clinical work?


Maybe you're booked solid and still not paying yourself what you're worth. Maybe you're the busiest person in your own clinic and it couldn't run two weeks without you. Maybe you want to start your own practice and can't tell if you're ready.


I'm Bryan Wright, DPT. I opened one physical therapy clinic in 2008 and grew it into a $50 million company with 21 locations. What I teach here is what I actually did.


Every week: how to start, run, and scale a physical therapy practice. Hiring and keeping good people. Pricing, cash flow, and what an owner should take home. Marketing that gets you found. When to take a partner. How to get out of the day to day.


Follow this channel if you want to own a business that serves your life, not a job with your name on the door.


Pilot North Group is a founding partnership for clinic owners.

bryan@pilotnorthgroup.com


#PhysicalTherapy #PTPractice #PrivatePracticePT

Whether you've been Jewish your whole life or just beginning your journey, Living Jewish Today invites you to learn, reflect, ask questions and find inspiration for living a vibrant Jewish life.

Welcome to The Learning Curve — the podcast about business, energy, leadership, and everything in between.
I’m Rom Barel, business developer and founder of NAVA MGMT, where we help businesses turn chaos into structure through systems, strategy, and smart growth.

Two decades later, she discovered the truth behind the day their lives unraveled: a federal search, an unseen investigation, and a story far darker than she ever knew. description:
Every great conversation starts with a good question. Not the kind that shows off, the kind that shows up.  A good question isn't trying to prove something, it's genuinely curious to hear the answer. 
These are the conversations host Amanda Lang has been having for more than three decades. Conversations about business, about politics, about the ideas and forces that shape our lives. 
Episodes of Good Question with Amanda Lang will drop weekly, starting September 9th.

title: Please Don't Quote Me!
author: ariherrz
description: Please Don’t Quote Me! is the unfiltered journal of Ari — a 20-something Latina college grad balancing her 9-5, a serious relationship, rent deadlines, and the chaos of trying to figure it all out. From candid rants and quiet reflections to pop culture takes and quarter-life crises, Ari shares the messy, real, sometimes hilarious process of girl bossing through adulthood (whatever that means). No quotes, no experts — just vibes.

title: The Business Code
author: Ethan Brooks
description:
The Business Code explores the hidden principles that make businesses grow, compete, and succeed.

Why do people buy things they don't need? Why can one product command a premium price while another struggles to sell? Why do some businesses scale effortlessly while others collapse under their own growth?

Hosted by Ethan Brooks, The Business Code goes beyond business headlines to decode the psychology, economics, strategies, incentives, and decisions that shape how businesses actually work.

Each episode breaks down a powerful business principle from pricing and customer behavior to growth, scalability, competition, retention, perceived value, margins, and the hidden costs of running a business.

This isn't a podcast about memorizing business jargon. It's about understanding the forces behind the decisions businesses make and the behaviors that drive customers, markets, and growth.

Whether you're an entrepreneur, business owner, executive, marketer, student, or simply curious about how business works, The Business Code gives you practical ideas you can understand, question, and apply.

Every business follows a code. We decode it.

Join me on your morning commute, hot girl walk, or lying in bed. Tune in for more episodes of my Digital Diaries.

title: Madrid Window
author: Madrid Window
description:
Madrid Window brings you real-time field recordings and urban soundscapes from Madrid, Spain.
Listen to fountains, streets, parks, traffic, birds and everyday city life — recorded on location with no music, narration or artificial sound design.
Made for focus, work, study, reading, relaxation, sleep and slow travel. From Retiro Park and Sabatini Gardens to quieter corners of Madrid, each episode is a window into the city as it sounds.
Occasional sound windows from elsewhere in Spain.

title: The Equine Nutrition Advisor

If you've ever wondered where you passion for equine nutrition can take you and want to learn from people out there doing it, you're in the right place!

title: Pocket Pastor: Sermons on Demand
author: KEITH LONG
description: From the pulpit to your pocket, here is Keith Long, a radically honest writer and ELCA Lutheran pastor sharing from his heart, mind, and soul during these amazing but troubling times. Listen to a religious skeptic and spiritually curious preacher like Pastor Keith as he pursues the truths of the ancient scriptures and ponders what Jesus the Christ might be asking of his followers today. Special thanks to St. Luke Lutheran Church in Cottage Grove, Minnesota (www.stlukecg.org) where Keith has preached and served as Senior Pastor since 2018.

title: Trust Yourself
author: Lilandra Lestz
description:
Trust Yourself is a podcast for anyone living in the in‑between. The space between who you were taught to be and who you’re becoming.
Hosted by Lilandra, a Latina who grew up without a clear cultural mirror, the show explores what it means to build identity without a blueprint. When the world around you wasn’t designed for your voice or your becoming, trusting yourself becomes a daily practice one that can feel tender, unfamiliar, and brave.
Through honest storytelling, soft reflection, and meaningful conversations with guests, each episode invites you back to yourself. This isn’t about perfection, performance, or polished self‑help. It’s about presence. It’s about learning to hear your own voice after years of overriding it. It’s about growing at your own pace, in your own way.
If you’ve ever felt out of place, in transition, disconnected from your roots, or unsure how to honor who you’re becoming, this space is for you.
Here, we talk about: • identity without a map • healing in real time • who you are beneath expectations • the courage of choosing yourself • stories that help you feel less alone
Trust Yourself is a grounding companion for the moments you don’t have language for the quiet, in‑between seasons where transformation is happening beneath the surface.
You don’t have to navigate your becoming alone.
Come as you are. Let’s walk this together.

Each episode features practical ideas, honest conversations, and insights from educators who are leading schools across Oklahoma. Whether you are an experienced administrator or preparing to take the next step in your leadership journey, Leading the Way offers encouragement, perspective, and strategies to help you grow and make a lasting impact.

The Home Earning podcast is a weekly podcast exploring how to make a living alongside home educating your child. From side hustles to main gigs, each week we interview a home educator who is making this life work for them and their family.
Hear their stories, discover new businesses, services and products, and get inspired to find new, fun ways to make some money whilst being at home with your child.

Jesus Girls Podcast

Jesus Girls Podcast, hosted by Malachi Dawson Kropf, is a place for women of God to grow, discover, and become everything God has called them to be.

Here, we dive into the everyday struggles women face and learn how to fight them with the Word of God. From taking back your authority and discovering your purpose to building confidence, strengthening your faith, and immersing yourself in Christian community, every episode is designed to remind you of who God says you are.

No matter your age or where you are in your walk with Jesus, there is an episode for you. We’re learning how to navigate relationships, identity, purpose, confidence, and everyday life—all while keeping Jesus at the center.

Let’s learn, grow, and become more like Jesus together.

This is a special, one-season release of the *Mission Shift* podcast from IVP author, Josh Irby. To continue listening to the podcast after Episode 5, subscribe to the full *Mission Shift* podcast here:
* Apple Podcasts ( https://www.cru.org/us/en/train-and-grow/audio/mission-shift.html#s )
* Spotify ( https://www.cru.org/us/en/train-and-grow/audio/mission-shift.html#season1 )
* iHeartRadio ( https://www.iheart.com/podcast/263-mission-shift-podcast-93602039 )
* Podcast Addict ( https://podcastaddict.com/podcast/mission-shift-podcast/3986163 )
Mission Shift is a podcast exploring how global missions is changing, especially as mission leadership and engagement increasingly come from everywhere to everywhere. Through conversations with global leaders, practitioners, and thinkers, each episode helps listeners pursue missions with humility, partnership, and wisdom.
*Welcome to Season 3 of Mission Shift*
“How does crosscultural partnership amplify global missions?” Let’s talk about it!
Building directly on previous seasons—which shined a spotlight on the global church on mission (Season 1) and explored how the West can best partner with them (Season 2)—this season dives into the central theme of cross-cultural partnership through the lens of the biblical figure Barnabas.
As the “modern missions era” gives way to the “new era of missions” and mission activity morphs from “the west to the rest” to “everywhere to everywhere,” Barnabas’ approach to mission is a compelling model to examine and learn from.
Throughout the season, we dialog with an array of international mission leaders and authors to unpack topics from the new InterVarsity Press book, The Barnabas Factor ( https://www.ivpress.com/the-barnabas-factor ). We’ll explore how humility, advocacy, mutual accountability, relational presence, and other factors can amplify global mission efforts in a shifting world.

title: An Act of Listening

title: Narratives of Care
author: Charlotte Bayala
description:
Caregiving is personal, but it is never isolated from the world around it.
Narratives of Care explores caregiving through the voices of people who have lived it, revealing how family, culture, place, history, community, relationships, and the systems around us shape the way we care for one another.
Hosted and produced by award-winning podcaster Charlotte Bayala, creator of The Cancer Caregiver Podcast and Caregiver Breathing Room, each season centers a different place, community, or shared experience.
Season One takes listeners to Puerto Rico, where cancer and dementia caregivers, family members, and local experts share what caregiving looks and feels like on the island. Told through voices in English and Spanish, the season asks a deceptively simple question:
Is caregiving the same everywhere?
These are not stories about the right way to care. They are stories about how care is actually lived.

title: Roast My Podcast | Podcast Marketing Teardowns & Growth Advice
author: Jeremy Enns & Justin Jackson | Podcast Marketing Strategists
description:
You only get one shot to win over a new podcast listener. Which means you need to make your first impression count. 

That's where we come in. 

In every episode, we roast one of our listener's show's podcast packaging to identify what they're doing well to attract new listeners... and where they're likely turning people off. 

Step by step, we walk through the typical podcast listener acquisition process and dissect each show's title, cover art, show description, episode titles & descriptions, and more.

Along the way, we break down the hidden psychology that causes listeners to choose one show over another, offer personalized marketing suggestions, and share our opinions on what works when it comes to podcast growth.

If you're looking to increase your discoverability and improve your podcast listener acquisition, we'd love for you to join us, and—if you dare—submit your own show to be seasoned, skewered, and roasted by leaving us a review with your show name.

title: Word & Page
author: Nokuthula Ndlovu

The Word and Page Podcast is a faith centered space where God's Word is alive through meaningful conversations, personal experiences, and thoughtful reflections. This podcast explores how scripture shapes our daily lives, strengthens our faith, and guides us through life's journeys.


Each episode features reflections on the Word of God, discussions on christian growth, and insights from books written by Nokuthula Ndlovu as well as inspiring authors, friends and guests who join her on the podcast. Together, we share stories, testimonies, lessons, and perspectives that encourage listeners in their own pursuit of Christlikeness and apply Biblical truth to everyday life.


Whether you are seeking exhortation, encouragement, Biblical wisdom, or engaging conversations about faith and literature, The Word and Page Podcast offers a welcoming space to learn, reflect, and grow.


Join us as we turn the pages of inspiring books, explore the depths of God's Word, and discover how faith transforms our lives.

title: Two Women Yelling About Knitting

description:
Hello and welcome to Two Women Yelling About Knitting. This is a space where we look up from our works in progress and acquisitions and talk about what we see in the wider world of knitting – its political, social, and historical context. But don't worry. It'll be fun!
We're friends who share a love of knitting as well as an interest in a lot of sticky topics that relate to knitting – traditional gender roles, consumerism, body liberation, and more. If you want to join us on this journey, hit the "Subscribe" button to follow along.

title: Dancing Goddess with Lamia Barbara

title: Beyond Her Title with Mary McGeorge

Because a title may tell you what she does—but it never tells you her whole story.
